newsitem.title: USA: Investors Insurance accepts Amex delisting.
newsitem.headline: Investors Insurance accepts Amex delisting.

text.p: Investors Insurance Group Inc said Tuesday it would not appeal the American Stock Exchange's decision to delist its common stock.
The company said it believed a market for its common stock would instead develop over the counter.
The Amex informed the company that it no longer satisfied the exchange's guidelines and that the current trading halt would not be lifted.
Investors Insurance Group, through its subsidiary Investors Insurance Corp, markets retirement annuities and senior insurance products.
